transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I had a bit of an outburst recently. I, uh... I blew up at one of the younger volunteers. It was just over a crooked tablecloth of all things. I don't usually talk to people that way, so... well, here I am.
Have you been paying a lot of attention to details like that tablecloth before?
No, I... I wouldn't say so. I don't usually care about things like that. I'm really not sure why it bothered me so much right then. It just did.
Have you been having thoughts that keep repeating in your mind lately?

Well... I suppose so. Just out of nowhere, really. I could just be sitting at my kitchen table, minding my own business, and... I'll hear that man's rough voice in my head. Or I just see the... the donation envelope hitting the ground. I don't really know why.
Do these repeating thoughts feel like they're invading your mind or are they more like thoughts you're intentionally thinking about?

Well... no, I'm certainly not trying to think about them. Like I was saying, they just kind of... force their way in. I'll just be sitting there and suddenly I'm hearing that voice again, or seeing that envelope drop. I'm definitely not bringing it up on purpose.
Do you feel like you have to do anything over and over to make these thoughts go away or to feel right?
No, I... I don't think so. I just try to ignore it, really. I don't do anything special.
Do you feel like you have to perform specific acts or rituals to relieve anxiety or distress?
No... no rituals or anything like that. I just... wait for it to pass.
Do you find yourself being very perfectionistic or meticulous in your daily life?
No... I wouldn't say so. I don't really fuss over things much. Just... do what needs doing, I suppose.
Have these thoughts or outbursts been affecting your daily life or relationships in any way?

Well... I suppose a little. I usually help organize the Día de los Muertos event, but I just... haven't been able to keep up with it this time. And I haven't been going to my card nights lately. I just don't really feel steady around people right now. That's about it.
Do you ever feel an overwhelming urge to repeat certain behaviors or actions?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get urges to do things over and over. I mostly just... keep to myself right now.
How much distress do these repeating thoughts and outbursts cause you?
I don't really know... I haven't thought about it like that. It's just... a bit bothersome, I suppose. I mostly just try not to dwell on it.
Do you feel like these repeating thoughts are trying to tell you something or make you do something?
No... not really. They're just... thoughts. They don't make me want to do anything. I just try to push them away when they happen.
Do you feel like you're trying to achieve something specific or prevent something from happening when these thoughts come into your mind?
No... I don't think so. I'm not trying to do anything like that. They just... happen, and I try to ignore them. That's all.
Do you feel afraid or anxious when these repeating thoughts happen?
No... I wouldn't say I'm afraid. They're just thoughts. I don't really get anxious about them... I just prefer to keep my mind on other things, I suppose.
Do you feel like these thoughts are senseless or unrealistic?
No... they're just thoughts. I don't really think about whether they make sense or not. They're just there, and I try not to dwell on them.
Would you say that these repeating thoughts and outbursts are causing you a lot of distress?

I suppose... a little. It's just that... well, I haven't been keeping up with organizing the Día de los Muertos event like I normally do. And I... I stopped going to my card nights. I just don't feel quite steady enough to be around people right now. That's all.
Do you feel like you have to respond or react in a specific way when these repeating thoughts happen?
No... not really. I don't... I don't feel like I have to do anything about them. I just let them pass.
Do you feel like these thoughts are unwanted when they happen?
I don't know. I haven't really thought about it in those terms. They just... happen, I guess. I don't pay much mind to whether I want them or not.
Do you feel like you must repeat certain actions or mental acts in response to these intrusive thoughts?
No... I don't do anything like that. Like I said, they just happen. I don't have any... routines or anything I need to do. I just wait for them to pass.
Would you say that these repeating thoughts and outbursts are interfering with your daily life in a major way?

I suppose... maybe a little. I don't know about major, but... well, I haven't been able to keep up with organizing the Día de los Muertos event. Not the way I usually do, anyway. And I... I guess I stopped going to card nights. I just don't feel very steady around people right now.
Do you feel like these repeating thoughts are obsessive?
I don't... I wouldn't call it that. I'm not obsessing over anything. Like I said before, they just... show up sometimes. I don't really think about it beyond that.
